name: cyera_dataport_agent
description: Answers questions about Cyera's Dataport Snowflake warehouse by reading schema context and running read-only SQL queries against it. Write/mutating SQL is rejected before it reaches the warehouse. Access requires an OAuth 2.0 access token issued via the Authorization Code flow (see securitySchemes.oauth2 below) -- callers act on behalf of a real, consenting end user, never on a static shared credential.

skills.name: get_cyera_dataport_snowflake_context
skills.description: Get context (documentation/schema) for executing queries on Cyera's DataPort in Snowflake.

skills.name: execute_dataport_query
skills.description: Execute a single read-only SQL query (SELECT/WITH/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN only) on Cyera's DataPort Snowflake warehouse. Requires having loaded Dataport schema context first in the same conversation.

scopes.offline_access: Refresh token, so Gemini Enterprise can keep calling this agent without the user re-authenticating every session.
